meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以处理基因组区间数据（BED 文件），包括训练 Region2Vec 区域嵌入、BEDspace 联合嵌入、scEmbed 单细胞嵌入，构建共识峰集，以及运行相关工具。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于 BED 文件分析、基因组区间机器学习、单细胞 ATAC-seq 处理或共识峰构建时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练这些 BED 文件的区域嵌入。
say.note: Claude 会执行 tokenization 并训练模型。

say.text: 用 scEmbed 分析我的单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据并聚类。
say.note: Claude 会加载数据、训练模型并生成细胞嵌入。

say.text: 构建一个共识峰集用于标准化多个实验。
say.note: Claude 会调用 universe build 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can work with genomic interval data (BED files), including training Region2Vec, BEDspace, scEmbed embeddings, building consensus peaks, and running related utilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about BED file analysis, genomic interval machine learning, single-cell ATAC-seq processing, or consensus peak building.

say_en.text: Train Region2Vec embeddings for these BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will tokenize and train the model.

say_en.text: Analyze my single-cell ATAC-seq data with scEmbed and cluster.
say_en.note: Claude loads data, trains model, and generates embeddings.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peak set to standardize multiple experiments.
